title: Haider haider haider haider
body:
Haider haider haider haider
HAIDER HAIDER HAIDER HAIDER..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Shere Khuda, Daamade Payamber
HAIDER HAIDER HAIDER HAIDER
<<DIVIDER>>
Shafae Mehshar, Sakiye Kausar
HAIDER HAIDER HAIDER HAIDER
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Bolna maine jab seekha tha, maa ne meri ye mujhse kaha tha..(2)
Bolo beta jaan laga kar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
HAIDER HAIDER HAIDER HAIDER
2. Meri wasiyat yaad ye rakhna, qabr ke bahar tum sab kehna..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Khud mai kahunga qabr ke andar..(2)
HAIDER HAIDER HAIDER HAIDER
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Wakif the aadabe wila se, kalma adhura kaise padhte..(2)
Daste nabi par bole kankar… Haider Haider Haider Haider
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Shabbar aur shabbir ho raazi, sehwan wala peer ho raazi..(2)
Bolo sakhi shahbaaz qalandar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Haider Haider Haider Haider
5. Dono hai ye roohe wilayat, dono hai ye jaane wilayat..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Allaho akbar Allaho akbar..(2)
Haider Haider Haider Haider
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Zikre Ali par paabandi thi, lekin Zainab aise boli..(2)
Goonj utha darbaar ke andar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
HAIDER HAIDER HAIDER HAIDER
7. Usko laga rehta hai khatra, bigda hua hai jiska shajra..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Aa nahi sakta uski zabaa par..(2)
HAIDER HAIDER HAIDER HAIDER
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Doobne waali thi jab kashti, Nuh ne aakhir kisko sadaa di..(2)
Bas ye sadaa thi Nuh ke lab par..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
HAIDER HAIDER HAIDER HAIDER
9. Meesum se ye mujhko mili hai, maine kitaabe ishq padhi hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Pehla sabak hai uske andar..(2)
HAIDER HAIDER HAIDER HAIDER
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Chehre ko dhaake aae Ghaazi, Siffeen me aisi jung ladi thi..(2)
Ran me sadaa thi ye to wahi hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
HAIDER HAIDER HAIDER HAIDER
11. Hasi ka aisa teer chala tha, laakho ka lashkar mar hi gaya tha..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Pote aakhir kiske hai Asghar..(2)
HAIDER HAIDER HAIDER HAIDER
<<DIVIDER>>
12. Maut se darta hai na daraa hai, ishq ‘Takallum’ bol raha hai..(2)
Daar ke upar zere khanjar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
HAIDER HAIDER HAIDER HAIDER
author: Mir Hassan Mir
